svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cluster shaft: cut 25 mm keyed shaft to 490 mm; chamfer both ends 1 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The key runs its full length (bought keyed stock).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Countershaft: cut 20 mm keyed shaft to 124 mm; chamfer both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The cluster shaft runs in the two 25 mm flange bearings 336 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: apart and carries the 20-tooth sprocket inside the chain case.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each end carries a hub: the taper-lock bush clamps it to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shaft, its outer face flush with the shaft end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The countershaft sits 143.9 mm up the frame and 15 mm behind the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cluster shaft, in two 20 mm flange bearings 86 mm apart, one on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each case plate; its two sprockets sit between them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both shafts slide through their bearings by hand before

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bearing grub screws are tightened.
